description:
Create an invoice.

Lines are prices (`{ price, quantity }`) or your own (`{ description, amount, quantity }`), in one currency. For a single amount, `amount` + `description` is short for one line. `customer` is an id or `{ email }`. A price line may carry its own `description` ("Seat #12"), and `discount` takes an amount off this invoice alone. The buyer pays at `url`, choosing bitcoin or a stablecoin there. Live mode: a new invoice is refused with 403 `bill_overdue` while a Perly Pay bill is unpaid past its 14 days, until it is paid in the dashboard's Billing; invoices already made are still paid.

Test keys only: refused with a live key.

amount.description: One amount instead of line_items in minor units (cents), an integer.

currency.description: For lines without a price. Default: your account's currency.

customer.description: A customer id, or `{ email }` to find or make one.

customer_email.description: Without `customer`: finds or makes the customer by email.

discount.description: A one-off amount off this invoice (a credit you owe the buyer; not with `coupon`) in minor units (cents), an integer.

expires_in_minutes.description: Until when a rail may be chosen.

custom_amount.description: Pay-what-you-want: the amount per unit in minor units (cents), an integer.

amount.description: Price per unit in minor units (cents), an integer.

metadata.description: Your own key–value pairs (≤ 50 keys, values ≤ 500 characters). On an update they are merged in; an empty value removes its key.

return_url.description: Where the buyer's page sends them back.

title: Create an invoice
